title: Cannot build recent pulls from the main repo.  AGP version error
body:
For a few weeks now I have not been able to build any pulls I have made from this main repository due to the following error on Gradle sync after a Clean.
The project is using an incompatible version (AGP 8.13.2) of the Android Gradle plugin. Latest supported version is AGP 8.1.3
See Android Studio & AGP compatibility options.

Any ideas on why this is occurring and how to fix it?  Cannot run the AGP Update Assistant, as it never does anything but spin wheels.  And all other attempts are either not relevant or do not work.

I have hard reset the local repo to no avail.

comments.body: Would you please not open an issue as a first action?
